title: SolWear application manifest
description: manifest.json at the root of a .swa package. See docs/pages/app-manifest-reference.md and section 5 of the architecture specification.

id.description: Reverse-DNS application identifier. Immutable once published.

name.description: Display name shown in the launcher and the store.

version.description: Semantic version, MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, no v prefix.

sdk.description: The @solwear/sdk line this app was built against.

entry.description: HTML entry point, relative to the archive root. May not escape the archive.

icon.description: PNG icon, relative to the archive root. Optional for sideload, expected for the store.

capabilities.description: Capability names. Each maps to a JSON-RPC method prefix.

author.description: Publisher name. Must match the registry entry's publisher field.

description.description: One sentence, shown in the store listing.
